# Customer and Order Data Processing and Aggregation

Flow Diagram section added with PNG image!

Here is the updated FRD:

1. Requirement ID: FRD-001
2. Title: Customer and Order Data Processing and Aggregation
3. Description: The requirement is to process customer and order data from CSV files, load it into Delta tables, perform data cleansing, create a summary table using SCD Type 2, and aggregate customer spend data.

4. Product Owner: 
The product owner for this requirement is responsible for ensuring that the development team has a clear understanding of the business needs and priorities. The product owner will be available to clarify requirements and provide input on the implementation.

5. Preconditions:
* The source CSV files for customer and order data are available at the specified locations.
* The necessary catalog and schema exist in the Databricks environment.

6. Main Flow / Functional Steps:
* Read source CSV data from the specified volumes and load it into Delta tables for customer and order data.
  - Customer data: /Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/customerdata
  - Order data: /Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/orderdata
* Remove "Null"/Null and duplicate records from both the customer and order tables.
* Create the "ordersummary" table if it does not exist in the catalog "gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe" and schema "sdlc_wizard".
* Join customer and order data using the "CustId" field and load the data into an SCD Type 2 table "ordersummary".
* Implement logic to update the SCD Type 2 "ordersummary" table when there are changes in the customer table, marking old records as Inactive and new records as Active, and updating StartDate and EndDate accordingly.
* Create the "customeraggregatespend" table if it does not exist with columns "Name", "TotalAmount", and "Date".
* Aggregate the "TotalAmount" from the "ordersummary" table, grouping by "Name" and "Date", and load the aggregated data into the "customeraggregatespend" table.

7. Flow Diagram:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
A[Read Customer CSV] --> B[Read Order CSV]
B --> C[Load Customer to Delta]
C --> D[Load Order to Delta]
A --> D
D --> E[Remove Null/Duplicates from Customer]
E --> F[Remove Null/Duplicates from Order]
F --> G[Create ordersummary table if not exists]
G --> H[Join Customer & Order Data]
H --> I[Load to SCD Type 2 ordersummary]
I --> J[Update SCD Type 2 on Customer Change]
J --> K[Create customeraggregatespend table if not exists]
K --> L[Aggregate TotalAmount by Name & Date]
L --> M[Load to customeraggregatespend]
```
